name: self-improve
description: A self-learning loop: saves durable facts to Hindsight and a local store, proposes reusable skills for your approval, improves them from use, and recalls past knowledge.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the whole learner on or off.

nudgeModel.title: Memory model
nudgeModel.description: Model that picks durable facts to keep (a small one is enough).

skillModel.title: Skill model
skillModel.description: Model that drafts, rewrites and merges skills.

nudgeEveryTurns.title: Memory nudge every N turns
nudgeEveryTurns.description: Ask what is worth keeping after this many turns (1 to 200).

minToolCallsForSkill.title: Tool calls that count as a complex task
minToolCallsForSkill.description: A task with at least this many tool calls may become a skill proposal (1 to 200).

approvalMode.title: Skill approval
approvalMode.description: ask: proposals wait in the pane. auto: they are written at once.

maxInjectTokens.title: Injected context budget (tokens)
maxInjectTokens.description: Most tokens the learner adds to the system prompt (50 to 4000).

dailyTokenCap.title: Daily learner token cap
dailyTokenCap.description: The learner stops for the day when its tokens reach this. 0 means no cap.

nudgeMaxInputTokens.title: Memory job: max input tokens
nudgeMaxInputTokens.description: Token limit for this learner job.

nudgeMaxOutputTokens.title: Memory job: max output tokens
nudgeMaxOutputTokens.description: Token limit for this learner job.

skillMaxInputTokens.title: Skill job: max input tokens
skillMaxInputTokens.description: Token limit for this learner job.

skillMaxOutputTokens.title: Skill job: max output tokens
skillMaxOutputTokens.description: Token limit for this learner job.

rewriteMaxInputTokens.title: Rewrite job: max input tokens
rewriteMaxInputTokens.description: Token limit for this learner job.

rewriteMaxOutputTokens.title: Rewrite job: max output tokens
rewriteMaxOutputTokens.description: Token limit for this learner job.

hindsightEnabled.title: Use Hindsight
hindsightEnabled.description: Save to and recall from your Hindsight server. Off keeps everything local.

hindsightBaseUrl.title: Hindsight base URL
hindsightBaseUrl.description: For example https://hindsight.example.com. Empty means local only.

hindsightApiKeyEnv.title: Hindsight key variable
hindsightApiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the API key. The key itself is never stored.

codegraphEnabled.title: Use CodeGraph
codegraphEnabled.description: In a repo with a .codegraph folder, ground learning in real symbols.
